# Contributing

## Ground rules

* Edit files under `src/` only. `dist/` is generated by `npm run build` and is
  git ignored; never commit it.
* Keep pull requests focused on one change.
* Run `npm run check` before opening a pull request. CI runs the same checks.

## Local development

```bash
npm install
npm run dev      # serves src/ on http://127.0.0.1:8080
```

## Checks

| Command          | What it does                                          |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `npm run build`  | Copy `src/` to `dist/` and stamp the version.        |
| `npm run lint`   | Biome lint on `scripts/` and `tests/`.              |
| `npm run format` | Biome format (writes) on `scripts/` and `tests/`.   |
| `npm test`       | Playwright smoke tests against the built `dist/`.    |
| `npm run check`  | `build` then `lint` then `test`.                    |

`src/index.html` is one large self contained file and is not yet linted or
formatted by Biome. Match the surrounding style when editing it.

## Versioning

The version lives in `package.json` only. `npm run build` stamps it into
`dist/index.html` (replacing the `data-app-version` value and the brand text).
When you cut a release, bump `package.json` and add a `cl-release` block to the
changelog section of `src/index.html`.

## Commit messages

Short imperative subject, then a body explaining why. Reference issues where
relevant.
